items.memoText:
VETO MESSAGE - No. 40
 
TO THE ASSEMBLY:
 
I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill:
 
Assembly Bill Number 2520, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to amend the social services law, in relation to providing
      parity to durable medical equipment providers by  requiring  Medi-
      caid  managed care organizations to reimburse such providers at no
      less than one hundred percent of the  medical  assistance  durable
      medical equipment and complex rehabilitation technology fee sched-
      ule for the same service or item"
 
    NOT APPROVED
 
  This  bill  would establish a minimum payment through Medicaid Managed
care for durable medical equipment (DME),  prosthetics,  orthotics,  and
related  supplies,  by requiring the Medicaid managed care plans pay DME
providers at no less than the rate set for use in the Medicaid  fee-for-
service (FFS) program.
 
  If  signed  into  law, this bill would place an additional cost on the
Medicaid program of $145 million per year that is not accounted  for  in
the State Financial Plan.
 
  Therefore, I am constrained to veto this bill.
 
  The bill is disapproved.                       (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                               __________
